senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. preced.) to push on, drive, press.
units: Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII, 7 ואין אחד מהם נוֹגֵשׂ אותך וכ׳ none of them presses thee &c., v. נָגַשׁ.—נוֹגֵשׂ task-master. Tanḥ. Sh’moth 9 אותו נ׳ עשוי וכ׳ that taskmaster was appointed over &c.; Ex. R. s. 1 נ׳ ממונה על עשרה שוטרים one (Egyptian) taskmaster was appointed over ten (Israelitish) officers.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 32:4">Lev. R. s. 32</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>קרץ נ׳ גבי וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>קדם</he>) the taskmaster came early to the officer, saying, go and gather thy men &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נוֹגְשִׂים</he>, <he>נוֹגְשִׂין</he>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 32:4">Ib.</cite>; Ex. R. l. c.
Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLVIII נוֹגְשֵׂי פרעה the taskmasters appointed by Pharaoh; a. fr.—Esp. to exact a debt.

<cite ref="Makkot 3b:1">Macc. 3ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 15:2">Deut. XV, 2</cite>) <he>לא קרינן ביה לא יִגּוֹשׂ</he> we do not apply to him (he does not violate the law) ‘he shall not exact’; <he>סוף אתי לידי יגוש</he> he will finally (after the lapse of ten years) transgress &c.—
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 113:1">Sifré Deut. 113</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 15:3">Deut. XV, 3</cite>) <he>ואת אחיך לא תִגּוֹשׂ</he> but thou must not exact of thy brother.
